organiser.name: NZ Tattoo & Art Festival Ltd (organiser Brent Taylor)

attendance.note: Sunset Tattoo blog (Nov 2019): '7000 people passed through the doors of the TSB Stadium', the festival's biggest crowd to that date; third-party report quoting organiser Brent Taylor. No later figure found.

ticket_price.note: 2026: 1 day $35, 2 day $60 (plus service fee) online via Eventfinda; higher at the door. Kids 14 and under free with a paying adult.
